title: ATI
summary: US specialty-materials producer supplying titanium and nickel alloys to aerospace.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

ATI produces titanium, nickel-based superalloys and specialty steels for aerospace, defence and medical customers. Its alloys go into jet engines, airframes and rocket components where high strength-to-weight and heat resistance are required. Aerospace build rates and certification cycles drive demand.

Technology Exposure

  • Titanium and nickel superalloys
  • Specialty steel and forgings
  • Aerospace and defence materials

What To Watch

  • Aerospace build rates
  • Defence spending
  • Raw-material and energy costs

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
